title: DMA completes but the buffer looks stale
description: A Cortex-M system with data cache receives a DMA completion interrupt, but the CPU reads old bytes from the destination buffer. Diagnose possible causes and propose a buffer ownership and cache-maintenance policy. Assume the DMA engine is not cache coherent.
prompt: A Cortex-M system with data cache receives a DMA completion interrupt, but the CPU reads old bytes from the destination buffer. Diagnose possible causes and propose a buffer ownership and cache-maintenance policy. Assume the DMA engine is not cache coherent.
constraints: State assumptions and separate measurements from guarantees.
rubric: Describe separate CPU cache and memory views.
Discuss cache-line alignment and avoiding unrelated dirty data in maintained lines.
Describe direction-specific clean/invalidate operations and barriers using target documentation.
follow_ups: What changes for a transmit DMA transfer?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
